latest_release.name: IINA 1.5.1
latest_release.body:
IINA 1.5.1 fixes several important issues in 1.5.0 and improves the overall user experience.

## Bug fixes  
- Fixed an issue where the player window is taller than expected.  
- Fixed an issue where thumbnails try to show frame outside of video duration #6423.  
- Fixed an issue where IINA doesn’t quit if using legacy full screen #6424.  
- Fixed incorrect OSC size when using “Reduced Motion” #6440.  
- Fixed quick setting controls not updated correctly #6455.  
- Fixed Clear Playback History doesn’t work.  
- Fixed wrong play slider orientation for RTL languages #6504.  
- Fixed permissions/parsing issues of XMLPRC.  
- Fixed plugin-managed players don’t prevent sleep #6449.  
- Fixed Assrt online subtitle search doesn’t work #6564.  
  
## Improvements  
- Clicking on the titlebar menu now highlights the next level folder/file #6448.  
- Display more potential metadata as track title when the track title is missing #6453.  
- Left click with ⌘ pressed on doc icon in titlebar shows path menu #6462.  
- Non-ASCII keys can be now used as keybindings #6474.  
- Show permission alert if an update changed allowed domain.  
  
## Plugin API  
- Expose a new `getTheme()` api to get appearance info.  Please see the [type definition on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/iina-plugin-definition) and the [documentation](https://docs.iina.io/interfaces/IINA.API.Core.html#getTheme).

---

In-app update will be available in 24 hours.
